_readme: Every relic in the game. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. RELICS ARE DRAFTED PER RUN: three are offered at the start of a descent, the player keeps one for that run only, and it is gone when the run ends — nothing here is permanent progression. rarity is an AUTHORED statement about how often the relic should be offered — unlike item rarity it is not derived from a tier, because a relic has no numbers to derive it from; changing a relic's band is this one word and nothing else. OMIT effect for a relic that has no mechanic yet — it resolves to None, which is exempt from the one-relic-per-effect rule precisely so a pool of named-but-unimplemented relics can exist. Every other effect must still be unique: two relics doing the same thing makes one of them a dead choice in a draft. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.
_placeholders: forest_wardens_tooth is DELIBERATELY MECHANIC-LESS -- it exists so the draft, the rarity ladder and the glossary can be seen working against a pool big enough to be a real choice, before anybody has designed what it does. It is the only one left; every other relic that used to sit in this state (seven_teeth through drowned_lantern) has since earned an `effect`. Give it one when it earns one; until then it is honest about being furniture. The 20 relics from balance pass 2 (magic_marker through phoenix_egg) point iconPath at Assets/_Project/Art/Generated/disc_metal.png -- a baked metallic-coin placeholder (see ProceduralSpriteBaker) -- until each earns real art from Art/Items/Relics/Processed/; they are not mechanic-less, only unillustrated.

relics.description: Whenever this character attacks, they strike the same target a second time.
After casting, the next hit this character takes is reduced by half.
Killing an enemy grants this character another turn.
Killing an enemy pays gold equal to about 30% of its own experience reward (minimum 1 gold).
Every attack you land reduces all of your active cooldowns by 1 turn.
The lower your health, the harder and faster you fight - up to +30% damage and +20% speed at 25% health or below, scaling smoothly in between.
Casting a spell grants +20% speed for your next turn.
Each attack you land permanently speeds you up by 10% for the rest of the fight, up to +40% total.
Every third attack you land this fight deals 40% bonus damage.
A spell that lands marks its target; your next attack against a marked target deals 50% bonus damage.
Taken from the thing that guards the first wood. It has no power yet.
Strikes 20% harder, and bruises just as easily.
Forty more health, carried slowly.
Every fourth spell you cast this fight deals 50% bonus damage.
+25 physical resistance and +25 magical resistance.
Landing a spell on an enemy immediately follows with a free basic attack against them.
Every landed attack rolls one of three outcomes at random - heal 5% health and 10% mana, splash 25% of the damage onto every other enemy, or slow the target by 30% speed for a turn.
A single-target damaging spell you cast repeats itself once more on the same target, for free.
Your spells mark the enemy they hit. Hitting a marked enemy with an attack consumes the mark and restores 20% of your missing mana (or signature resource).
Marks every enemy the instant combat begins.
The instant you drop below 30% health, every enemy is feared for 1 turn. Re-arms once you climb back above 30%.
Damaging an enemy lowers its resistances by 3% for 3 turns, stacking up to 15%. Each stack falls off on its own.
Every enemy you kill (summons excluded) grants +2% damage for the rest of the run.

relics.displayName: Pointy Nail on the End of a Stick
relics.description: Melee attacks gain 35 flat armour penetration.
After casting a convergence ability, gain 50% damage reduction for 2 turns. Only offered to a party with a convergence ability.
Attacks apply a 10% slow, stacking up to 40%.
At the start of the fight, stun one random enemy for 1 turn.
Your melee attacks can reach any enemy, regardless of position.
Super-effective damage is multiplied by an extra 20%.
Choosing to Move grants +30% Speed for 1 turn.
Any action of yours that changes a position on the field grants a 15% ward, once per turn.
After an enemy dies (summons excluded), heal 3% of your max health.
Whenever an enemy summons a unit, deal 100% of your max health as damage to the summoner.
They say hell and heaven have the same master key. Once per combat, an enemy you kill answers its call for one last blow against its own side.
After you attack, cast a spell or use an ability, you slip one position forward in the turn order.
Getting hit lowers all of your active cooldowns by 1 turn, once per turn.
10% vampirism - heal for a tenth of the damage your attacks deal.
Taking what would be fatal damage instead turns you into an egg for 3 turns, with its own HP pool. Revive with whatever fraction of it survives, or die if it breaks. Once per combat.
